mapper.sql: A.SEQNO AS seqno, A.PROD_ID AS prodId, A.PROD_NAME AS prodName, A.PORTFOLIO_ID AS portfolioId, A.ASSET_ID AS assetId, A.ASSET_NAME AS assetName, A.MARKET_ID AS marketId, A.MODEL_ASSET_TYPE AS modelAssetType, A.MODEL_ASSET_DETAIL_TYPE AS modelAssetDetailType, A.MDATE AS mdate, A.UPDATE_TIME AS updateTime, A.FINANCIER AS financier, A.GRADE_ORG_ID AS gradeOrgId, A.ISSUER AS issuer, A.ACTUAL_CREDIT AS actualCredit, A.SPONSOR AS sponsor, A.RISK_LEVEL_FIVE AS riskLevelFive, A.TRADE_ID AS tradeId, A.TRADE_DATE AS tradeDate, A.PS AS ps, A.SHARE_AMT AS shareAmt, A.YIELD AS yield, A.PAPER_RATE AS paperRate, A.PLAN_END_DATE AS planEndDate, A.IS_CLEAN AS isClean, A.DEC_DATE AS decDate, A.O_TYPE AS oType, A.RESULT_01 AS result01, A.RESULT_02 AS result02, A.RESULT_ISSUER AS resultIssuer, A.RESULT_FINANCIER AS resultFinancier, A.RESULT_SPONSOR AS resultSponsor, A.RESULT_ACTUAL_CREDIT AS resultActualCredit, A.O_TYPE_FINAL AS oTypeFinal, A.ORG_ID_FINAL AS orgIdFinal, A.IS_FIN_LICENCE AS isFinLicence, A.RESULT_DEAL AS resultDeal, A.RESULT_CURRENT AS resultCurrent, A.PRIN_OVERDUE_DAY AS prinOverdueDay, A.INT_OVERDUE_DAY AS intOverdueDay, A.FIN_STAGE AS finStage, A.EMA_SHARE_AMT AS emaShareAmt, A.EAD AS ead, A.PRE_PROSPECTIVE_PD AS preProspectivePd, A.PROSPECTIVE_PD AS prospectivePd, A.LGD AS lgd, A.PRE_PROSPECTIVE_ECL AS preProspectiveEcl, A.PROSPECTIVE_ECL AS prospectiveEcl, A.PROCESS AS process, A.CREATE_USER AS createUser, A.CREATE_DEPT AS createDept, A.CREATE_TIME AS createTime, A.UPDATE_USER AS updateUser, A.IS_CONTAIN_PLEDGE AS isContainPledge, A.TRADE_AMT AS tradeAmt, A.ISSUE_AMT AS issueAmt, A.COUPON_SPECIES AS couponSpecies, A.ISSUE_PRICE AS issuePrice, A.VDATE AS vdate, A.GRADE_ORG_TYPE AS gradeOrgType
mapper.select: select A.OPTIMISTIC_WEIGHT optimisticWeight, A.BASIC_WEIGHT basicWeight, A.PESSIMISM_WEIGHT pessimismWeight from MOD_PD_WEIGHT_CONFIG A WHERE ROWNUM =1 ORDER BY UPDATE_TIME DESC

select A.SEQNO as seqNo, '03' as configType, #{yearNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL} as yearNum, #{yearNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL} as yearStr, A.FORWARD_YEAR_PD as forwardYearPd from MOD_GRADE_PD_CONFIG A where A.GRADE_RESULT=#{gradeResult,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.VOUCH_YEAR = (select max(B.vouch_year) from MOD_GRADE_PD_CONFIG B where B.vouch_year <= #{yearNum,jdbcType=DECIMAL} and B.PD_CONFIG_TYPE = '01' ) AND A.PD_CONFIG_TYPE = '01' AND ROWNUM=1

select A.SEQNO as seqNo, '04' as configType, A.VOUCH_YEAR as ouchYear, A.VOUCH_QUARTER as vouchQuarter, A.OPTIMISTIC_FACTOR as optimisticFactor, A.BASIC_FACTOR as basicFactor, A.PESSIMISM_FACTOR as pessimismFactor from MOD_PD_FACTOR_CONFIG A inner join ( select A2.VOUCH_YEAR as VOUCH_YEAR, max(A2.VOUCH_QUARTER) as VOUCH_QUARTER from MOD_PD_FACTOR_CONFIG A2 where A2.VOUCH_YEAR =(select max(A1.VOUCH_YEAR) from MOD_PD_FACTOR_CONFIG A1 where A1.VOUCH_YEAR >= #{yearStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) and TO_NUMBER(A2.VOUCH_QUARTER) >= TO_NUMBER(#{quarterStr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) and rownum=1 group by A2.VOUCH_YEAR,A2.VOUCH_QUARTER order by A2.VOUCH_QUARTER desc
) C on A.VOUCH_YEAR=C.VOUCH_YEAR and A.VOUCH_QUARTER =C.VOUCH_QUARTER
